items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Aunt Lee, my mother's older sister.

ctx.x: You know, she'd make one there and bring it on the sub, all the way to New York, so that I could have my pie, my sweet potato pie. And when I was in town, when I was at the
Savoy, I'd have a matinee at 4:00. She was there. And then I'd go over and see her now and then. Aunt Lee, I called her. Aunt Lee, my mother's older sister.

And, you don't know how I got my name. My mother was working at this school in Birmingham called Erskine Ramsey High. And, my mother and the president, you know, the president liked my mother very much. She was back there in the kitchen, making, cooking, you know, things like that.
